title: Turkish Kickin' Kebab
description: A savory and sweet Turkish-inspired kebab recipe with a kick of spice. Perfect for a quick and delicious dinner.

ingredients.name: Turkish Kebab Meat
ingredients.notes: Make sure to slice the meat thinly against the grain

ingredients.name: Peach Salsa
ingredients.notes: Combine diced peaches with red onion, jalapeno, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime juice

ingredients.name: Kicked Up Tzatziki Sauce
ingredients.notes: Combine yogurt with cucumber, garlic, dill, and a pinch of cayenne pepper

ingredients.name: Crispy Onions
ingredients.notes: Thinly slice onions and fry until crispy

instructions: Thread Turkish Kebab Meat onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked to your liking.
Meanwhile, toast some pita bread and top with Crispy Onions, Peach Salsa, and a dollop of Kicked Up Tzatziki Sauce.
Serve the grilled kebabs with the toasted pita and toppings.
